posts.title_en: Guild Conquest 1T high-score deck guide ft. Melon Soda
posts.summary_en: 누리머 runs a 2.35G-power Melon Soda (메소) deck that scores 1,031,191,001,321 (~1.03T), personal rank 430th. Melon Soda, Pinot, Tiger Lily and Dark Choco are Lv.1 so that Pomegranate's buff doesn't scatter. He switched from Panda Dumpling (18% lift resistance) to Candy Shade Pouch (30% lift resistance, +10% HP) to keep the formation from breaking. Cherry deck = lower ceiling but stable; Melon Soda deck = higher ceiling, needs move-speed setup and endless retries; his lowest and highest scores differ by more than 3×.

posts.title_en: Guild Conquest update: 1T 86G damage, Milk & Cheesecake buff mechanics
posts.summary_en: PonPonLin (TW client) scores 1,086,717,570,926 (1T 86G) with a 2.61G team that adds Coffee Cookie Lv.70 instead of Cherry/Melon Soda, with low-level (Lv.50/60) fillers rather than Lv.1. Every cookie's card stats (ATK) are shown to set the ATK order below Cheesecake's 735.85K. He explains that Milk and Cheesecake exchange ATK buffs to get around non-stacking, and that Pomegranate's tether randomly prefers attack-speed units and the current highest-ATK unit. Full sugar runes and all 7 gear pieces are shown.
